content:
Registration for the next Workshop that BUILT CoLAB is organising in the framework of the “Circularity in Construction” initiative is now open.

📢 Workshop | How to go from theory to action in incorporating recycled materials in the Construction sector 📅 Thursday, January 27 | ⏰15:00 – 17:00 | 📌 Online 🗣 Speakers: Ana Cristina Freire and Isabel Martins | LNEC

This Workshop aims to internalise knowledge that enables companies under current conditions to incorporate recycled materials into the construction sector and to understand what blockages exist through the exchange of experiences and realities between people.

Speakers will make a first part of presentations on the topic, followed by a working session in which participants will have the opportunity to give their contribution to identify the main blockages to circularity and solutions to address them.

Participation is free, but registration required 👉 here.

Find out more about this and upcoming initiatives, workshops and capacity building actions at https://circularidade.builtcolab.pt/.

This Workshop is held under the Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry, the Collaboration Protocol between BUILT CoLAB, the Ministry of the Environment and Climate Action and the Environmental Fund, and which also has as partner entities the Confederation of Portuguese Industry (CIP), the CPCI – Portuguese Confederation of Construction and Real Estate, AICCOPN – Association of Civil Construction and Public Works Industrialists, AECOPS – Association of Construction and Public Works and Services Companies, PTPC – Portuguese Technological Platform for Construction, IMPIC – Institute for Public Markets, Real Estate and Construction, I. P., and the APA – Portuguese Environment Agency, I. P.
